subject: HANDOFF: exact opening-attempt owner fixes remap/orphan race
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-opening-owner-20261001T230257Z. WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=FINAL_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e; MAIN_CHANGED_DURING_RND=NO. Live board remains legacy /messages + /artifacts. STRONGEST_PROVEN_FINDING: service-global earlyOpeningVisualStarted is not bound to the specific PanelEngine that actually owns continuityOpeningVisual. syncDisplays() can destroy/remap engine A and create replacement cover engine B while the semantic OPENING_FROM_CLOSED/INNER_HANDOFF attempt remains valid; because the global started flag remains true, B never receives beginContinuityOpeningVisual(), orphaning the one-shot. SECOND CONFIRMED SOURCE ISSUE: reconcile clears earlyOpeningVisualLatched when coverEngines is temporarily empty, consuming the semantic attempt during route churn even though the controller deliberately preserves opening state across topology handoff. Reduced source-faithful baseline reproduces both failures; proposed stable exact-attempt owner passes 12/12 tests including deterministic 100,000-event fixed-seed adversarial stream. RECOMMENDATION: implement primary's accepted P0.2/P1.3 visual owner so one immutable opening attempt (serviceEpoch + openingCycle/movementId + attemptSequence + direction) survives host loss/remap; bind hostEpoch beneath it; temporary no-host means WAITING_FOR_HOST; cancel only on semantic completion/reversal, privilege/authority loss, exact-attempt timeout, user stop, or service epoch rollover. Remove earlyOpeningVisualStarted as ownership and do not reset/restart naked booleans on display callbacks. Preserve V9 early inner wake and existing thresholds. No production writes; Fold7 device remap validation still required.
